description: 40 realistic developer and scientist prompts (20 should_trigger=true, 20 should_trigger=false) that never mention mintfig, used to evaluate skill trigger recall and false-trigger rate.

prompts.prompt: Summarize our 5-variant ablation study from runs/ablation.csv (5 seeds each) showing test accuracy, 95% confidence intervals, and validation curves over 2,000 steps.
Compare our 6 model checkpoints across MMLU, HumanEval, GSM8K, and latency_ms from eval_results.json so the team can see which checkpoint to ship.
Explore sensor_readings.csv (1,800 rows across 4 reactor zones) and show me the trends, outliers, and spread across zones.
Analyze our triplicate dose-response CSV for 4 kinase inhibitors across 10 concentrations (0.001 to 30 uM) and compare IC50 inhibition against cell viability.
Show how four-probe conductivity varies across 5 Li-doping levels (0 to 4 at.%) from 80 K to 330 K and highlight which doping level gives the lowest activation energy.
Inspect differential_expression.tsv and compare log2 fold changes across 18 pathway genes for wild type, knockout, and rescue replicates.
Review plots/make_ablation.py before I paste its PNG into Slack — check whether the headline number actually matches the plotted data and whether labels are legible at chat width.
Prepare Figure 2 for our Nature submission: a 2-panel 89 mm single-column plate with exact millimeter dimensions, sans-serif typography, and preflight checks.
Build a double-column NeurIPS scaling law figure comparing 4 parameter scales with confidence bands, direct curve labels, and a reproducible submission bundle.
Look at ci_latency_24h.csv covering 6 microservices (p50, p95, p99 every 15 minutes) and show which service spiked and when the regression started.
Compare checkout latency distributions between control and treatment from rollout_samples.csv (n=400 per arm), highlighting medians and the p95 tail.
Compare validation loss trajectories over 50 epochs for 4 learning-rate schedules with plus/minus 1 s.d. across 3 random seeds from training_logs.csv.
Analyze cycle_life.csv for 8 pouch cells over 500 charge cycles, show when each cell crosses 80% capacity retention, and call out the defective cell.
Compute and display the pairwise Pearson correlation matrix across 8 crystal descriptors from descriptors_412.csv so we can drop redundant features.
Show user drop-off across our 6 onboarding stages from funnel_q4.csv along with the main drop reason at each step.
Profile our 7-stage ETL build trace in trace.json (start and end timestamps per stage) so we can see which parallel stages dominate wall-clock time.
Break down the monthly inference bill change from $42k to $68k across 8 cost drivers in billing_delta.csv so leadership sees what caused the jump.
Compare daily kWh consumption before and after the HVAC retrofit across 9 campus buildings in retrofit_energy.csv against the unretrofitted control building.
Audit the Matplotlib charts in notebooks/experiment_analysis.ipynb before we attach them to the PR — make sure there are no clipped labels, truncated bar axes, or wrong title numbers.
Turn benchmark_summary.csv (8 candidate models with accuracy, 95% CI, p99 latency, and GPU memory) into a clean comparison scorecard for our weekly review.
Fix the KeyError when optional metadata fields are missing in src/parser/loader.py.
Refactor src/services/billing.py to split invoice calculation and PDF rendering into two separate classes.
Write pytest unit tests covering expired tokens and invalid signatures in src/auth/jwt_validator.py.
Help me resolve the git rebase merge conflict in src/api/routes.py against origin/main.
Explain this Python traceback from our worker queue: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'encode' at line 142 of serializer.py.
Walk me through the high-level architecture of this repository and how requests flow from the CLI entrypoint to the storage layer.
Update our Dockerfile to use a multi-stage build with python:3.12-slim and cache pip wheels cleanly.
How many tests passed and how many failed in the last pytest run?
What was the single peak memory value in MB reported for run 42 in run42.log?
Just tell me the min, median, and max response time from this single endpoint check — three numbers is all I need.
Rename fetch_user_records to list_user_records across the codebase and update all imports and call sites.
Write an Alembic migration that adds a composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) to the events table.
Review my uncommitted git diff for race conditions, thread-safety bugs, and missing error handling.
Fix the mypy type annotation errors and ruff lint warnings in src/utils/retry.py.
Add a --timeout flag with a default of 30 seconds to the argparse CLI in scripts/sync_data.py.
Why is .github/workflows/ci.yml failing to restore the uv dependency cache on macOS runners?
Explain how the @retry_with_backoff decorator in src/http_client.py handles jitter and cancellation.
Bump the minimum httpx version to 0.27 in pyproject.toml and move black out of optional dev dependencies.
Add NumPy-style docstrings to the public functions in src/cache/lru.py.
Does the regex in src/versioning.py accept pre-release semver tags like 1.4.0-rc.2? Fix it if not.
